description: Show spending trends for a category across a window of months, ending in the month you name or this month. Identifies increasing/decreasing patterns.

category.description: Category name or ID. If omitted, shows trends for top spending categories.

month.description: The month the window ends in (YYYY-MM or natural language). Defaults to this month. Use it to look at a past period: month "2026-06" with months 3 reads April, May and June.

months.description: How many months the window covers. Defaults to 6, which is a default and not a limit: ask for 24 or 36 if that is what you want.

name: category_trends
